meta.name: short-drama-edit
meta.description: 将已生成的短剧镜头剪成成片，记录入出点、镜序、声音、字幕与交付规格。用于套剪、加字幕、统一响度、调整节奏或导出精修素材；需要补素材或修改故事时转回对应创作阶段。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散镜头剪成有字幕、声音统一的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一堆短剧素材要剪成能直接交付的成片
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered shots into a finished short drama with subtitles and even audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a pile of short-drama footage to cut into a deliverable film

howto.what: 把剧集里已生成的逐镜素材剪成成片:先写出剪辑单.md(入出点、镜序、声音、字幕、交付规格),再用 ffmpeg 切段拼接、烧字幕、统一响度,输出到 制作成果/成片/。它不生成新素材。
howto.when: 当 剧集/<EP>/制作成果/ 里已有本次要用的、可读的视频文件时接管;你要求套剪、加字幕、统一响度等剪辑工作时触发。

say.text: 用 $short-drama-edit 把 EP001 已生产的镜头剪成成片
say.note: 读已有素材,先写剪辑单再渲染

say.text: 给这版成片烧上字幕,响度统一到交付目标
say.note: 按剪辑单渲染并测量成片

say.text: 把第 3 段的入点往前挪,重新渲染
say.note: 先改剪辑单,再重出成片

howto.what_en: Turns existing per-shot footage into a finished cut: first writes 剪辑单.md (in/out points, shot order, sound, subtitles, delivery specs), then renders with ffmpeg to splice, burn subtitles and unify loudness into 成片/. It does not generate new footage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when footage already exists and is readable in 剧集/<EP>/制作成果/, and you ask to assemble, add subtitles, unify loudness or adjust pacing.

say_en.text: Use $short-drama-edit to cut EP001's shots into a finished film
say_en.note: Reads existing footage, writes 剪辑单.md, then renders

say_en.text: Burn subtitles into this cut and match the delivery loudness
say_en.note: Runs render and verify on the episode

say_en.text: Move cut 3's in point earlier and re-render
say_en.note: Updates 剪辑单.md first, then renders again
